emphasis_points: Position the dining set or table as the celebratory centerpiece of daily meals, morning rituals, and shared hospitality.
State exact seating capacity (2, 4, 6, 8 seater, or extendable mechanism) and leg/pedestal clearance for comfortable knee positioning.
Highlight tabletop surface durability (solid wood grain, chamfered edge profiles, protective sealer) and coordinated chair ergonomics (curved backrests, supportive upholstery).
avoid_list: Do not claim tabletop surfaces are impervious to hot pots, heat scorch, or deep liquid staining without coasters/mats.
Do not assume dining chairs or benches can fully tuck under table aprons unless dimensionally verified.
Do not invent extension leaves, butterfly mechanisms, or additional seating not specified in source data.
tone_notes: Warm, hospitable, and enduring, grounding the dining space in dependable craftsmanship and comfortable shared moments.
